bullets.text: Designed a Python multi-agent Machine Learning pipeline parsing incoming reviews into structured JSON classification, per-topic sentiment, supporting evidence quotes, and staff-name recognition to feed client reporting dashboards, contributing to a 20% lift in client retention.

Cut Python Machine Learning inference costs with a two-tier routing architecture: urgent single reviews go to the Gemini API for low-latency responses, while large batch jobs run on a self-hosted Gemma 27B on the company's own GPU hardware, keeping per-review inference costs down.

Raised subcategory recall from 0.78 to 0.96 (F1 0.98), measured on a 500-review golden set of hard cases, then locked in MLOps gains with a CI/CD regression suite that re-runs the dataset on every change and fails the build if accuracy drops.

Adopted by account managers to prepare for client meetings: per-dealer Machine Learning breakdowns show exactly where a dealership is struggling before the team walks in, sharpening renewal and upsell conversations.
